articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
articles.snippet: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
articles.snippet: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.snippet: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

articles.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
articles.snippet: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

articles.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.
